verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management SaaS, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair axis. The evidence covers only data export (CSV, case downloads), audit trails, and file renaming. Nothing documents retention policies, retention windows, or deletion of cases, attachments or customer data; export is an adjacent feature, not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
